purpose: Restore exact private source paths in a new environment, retaining frozen IDs, source hashes, profiles and normalized data.

path_resolution.missing: Unavailable required bytes →BLOCKED/exit2. Corrupt bytes/unsafe paths/conflicting declarations →FAIL/exit1. Exact complete byte/path preparation →PASS/exit0. This is not historical or runtime PASS.

Run verify_delivery_set.py on the core ZIP plus all3parts. It checks the entire manifest/catalog set and restores exact inputs/reference_sources.zip. Missing parts BLOCKED; altered bytes FAIL. Extract validated core files into a private directory and restore the reference ZIP at that directory/inputs/reference_sources.zip.

Materialize the42originals separately by existing IDs/hashes. If required original members are unavailable as current files, use pinned recheck_archives.py in its bounded static scope and provide that output as --source-root. Do not execute installers or downloaded code.

Run the resolver with --package-root, repeatable --source-root, --work-dir, --output and --report. It reads private preserved guide evidence and reference ZIP by hash, and emits full map plus exact step01 map. Inspect exit code, required/resolved IDs and every missing/failure record.

Run the emitted whole_byte_gate_command with work/step01_input_map.json; run emitted import_command with full map. Preserve known154NA source graph failures; integrityPASS does not promote semantic readiness or runtime.

If a specific original source is still missing, use its recorded ID/hash/location. Access failure is BLOCKED; different captures/hashes cannot silently replace originals. No new source discovery or network operation is done by the resolver. Work reproduction is not CodexG0.
